title: PDA
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office navigates various personal and romantic developments around Valentine's Day. Darryl receives support from coworkers as he reflects on his grandmother. Andy shares news of a date with Rachel and celebrates Darryl's birthday. Michael and Holly's new relationship is a focal point, with their public displays of affection causing mixed reactions among coworkers. Gabe plans a romantic treasure hunt for Erin, while Michael and Holly confront the challenges of a potential long-distance relationship and announce they are moving in together. The episode also features lighthearted moments and office banter around love and relationships.
